# Botnoob: Flagship AI Bot Studio

Botnoob is a specialized platform for deploying, hosting, and managing AI-powered bots for Telegram, Discord, and Web automation. It features a zero-lag studio environment, Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) intelligence, and native SwiftUPI webhook support.

## Key Endpoints for Agents

- Homepage: https://new.tg/
- Bot Templates: https://new.tg/templates (Source code foundations)
- Plugins: https://new.tg/plugins (Capabilities extensions)
- Documentation: https://new.tg/docs (API and deployment guides)
- Blog: https://new.tg/blog (Engineering insights)
- Pricing: https://new.tg/pricing (Plan details)

## Technical Stack
- Frontend: React (Vite, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion)
- API: Microservices (Node.js, Supabase, Redis, Nginx)
- Hosting: Global Edge Network
